fact: An abstract accepted at the 2025 DHIS2 Annual Conference states that the Impilo EHR, deployed across over 700 facilities, sends facility data to DHIS2 through three pipelines (real-time via OpenHIE, mobile backups for offline sites, manual backups), with middleware updating DHIS2 tracker programs and aggregate data for over 150 indicators and 15 facility registers, HIV registers first.
title: Integration and Interoperability of Impilo Electronic Health Record (EHR) system with DHIS2
